reject.title: Reject this review?
reject.body: It won’t be published. The customer sees a friendly explanation and can edit and send it again.
reject.toastBody: The customer has been told it couldn’t be published.

changes.title: Ask for changes
changes.body: The review stays unpublished. The customer sees your message in “My reviews” and can edit it.
changes.notePlaceholder: Thank you for your review! Could you…
changes.toastBody: The customer will see your message.

hide.title: Hide this review?
hide.body: It leaves the store until you restore it. Nothing is deleted, and the customer sees it as temporarily hidden.
hide.notePlaceholder: Why is it hidden, and what would bring it back?
hide.toastBody: You can restore it at any time.

flag.title: Flag for follow-up
flag.body: Adds an internal report. The review stays published and appears in “Reported”.
flag.toastBody: It’s now in the Reported tab.

keep.title: Keep this review published?
keep.body: Every open report is closed as reviewed. The review stays on the store unchanged.
keep.notePlaceholder: Why does it respect the guidelines?
keep.toastBody: Reports closed; the review stays published.

hideReported.title: Hide this reported review?
hideReported.body: The reports are closed and the review leaves the store until you restore it. Nothing is deleted.
hideReported.toastBody: Reports closed; you can restore it later.

remove.title: Remove this review?
remove.body: It leaves the store and is marked as rejected. The review, its reports and its history are kept on record; the customer is told it couldn’t be published.
remove.toastBody: It’s kept on record as rejected.

removeResponse.title: Remove the public response?
removeResponse.body: The review stays as it is; only Global Toothgems’ response disappears from the store.
removeResponse.toastBody: The review no longer shows a response.
